title: Optimum approximation by filtered clones
statement: Let $D$ and $V$ be finite sets, with $D$ nonempty, and let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template. For natural numbers $r,M$ with $0<M$ and $r\le M$, suppose every predicate selected by an outcome has arity at most $r$. Then the absolute difference between the optimum padded-clone value and the optimum value of the raw CSP instance formed from globally filtered clone occurrences is at most $r^2/M$.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
